Figure 2: Overview of the proposed MCSP method. The MCSP proceeds through three synergistic stages to achieve precise unsupervised intent discovery: (1) Contrastive Pretraining, which performs mask-based contrastive learning on multimodal inputs to establish a robust joint embedding space; (2) Concept Extraction, which leverages MLLM-guided reasoning to generate semantic concepts from high-quality representative samples; and (3) Semantic Propagation, which integrates evidence diffusion and concept-driven supervision to refine the embedding manifold for accurate intent identification.
